note: Per-report rootDir/filters/stdout/exitCode for deterministic replay through the amended-2 classifier. The six base reports are byte-copied from amended-1/fixtures/r4-runner/reports (immutable, hash-pinned in the sub-batch manifest); the four malformed-* controls are new. stdout pins only the load-bearing reporter lines (the Errors regex the grammar reads); full fresh live captures live in amended-2/evidence/.

mixed.report.json.why: unhandled runner error (reporter Errors line) present ALONGSIDE an intended failure — infrastructure, never detection (A3 order: Errors check precedes anyFail)

passskip.report.json.why: healthy passed + required skipped: skipped is never-executed, not a pass (A3 cx1 channel)

unhandled-only.report.json.why: single passed file but unhandled runner error in stdout with exit 1 — never a pass

wrong-identity.report.json.why: report carries unrequested tests/other-file.test.ts — wrong-identity run refused (full-path identity, both directions)

empty-results.report.json.why: testResults: [] — zero test files is never green (T-TAK-A)

unknown-shape.report.json.why: report carries only a snapshot key — numTotalTests absent, malformed grammar fails closed

malformed-total.report.json.why: numTotalTests absent — grammar requires a non-negative integer

malformed-success.report.json.why: success: "yes" — grammar requires boolean when present

malformed-file-status.report.json.why: file status 'flaky' outside the passed|failed vocabulary

malformed-assertion-status.report.json.why: assertion status 'bogus' outside the passed|failed|pending|skipped|todo vocabulary
